faq.title: [FR]Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question1: [FR]Is the free plan really free forever?
faq.answer1: [FR]Yes! Our Truly Free plan includes 1 human agent for life with unlimited conversations, chat history, and contacts. Plus, you get 1 AI agent with 100 lifetime AI replies to try our AI features. No credit card required, no hidden fees.
faq.question2: [FR]What's the difference between monthly and yearly billing?
faq.answer2: [FR]With yearly billing, you save 2 months on the Premium plan ($299/year vs $359.88/year if paid monthly). The billing cycle only affects the Premium plan - the Free plan is always free and Enterprise is custom pricing.
faq.question3: [FR]Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan anytime?
faq.answer3: [FR]Absolutely! You can change your plan at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately, and downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle.
faq.question4: [FR]What happens if I exceed my AI reply limit on the Free plan?
faq.answer4: [FR]The Free plan includes 100 lifetime AI replies. Once you reach this limit, you'll need to upgrade to Premium for unlimited AI responses. Your human agent functionality remains unlimited on all plans.
faq.question5: [FR]How does the Premium plan pricing work?
faq.answer5: [FR]Premium has two components: a license fee ($29.99/month or $299/year) plus usage-based pricing. Usage includes AI responses starting at $0.006 each (ChatGPT-4o mini) and voice calls at $0.12/minute. Additional human users cost $10/month each, and extra workspaces cost $15/month each.
faq.question6: [FR]What happens to my data if I cancel?
faq.answer6: [FR]You own your data. You can export all your chat history, contacts, and knowledge base content at any time, even on the free plan. We believe in data freedom and transparency.
faq.question7: [FR]Do you offer custom pricing for large enterprises?
faq.answer7: [FR]Yes! Our Enterprise plan offers custom builds, multiple AI services perfect for agencies, custom API integrations, and professional design guidelines with technical support. Contact our sales team for a personalized quote.

faq.subtitle: [FR]Everything you need to know about SeaVoice[FR] AI and how it can transform your business communications

q1.question: [FR]How does SeaVoice[FR] differ from a traditional chatbot?
q1.answer: SeaVoice[FR] provides real-time voice conversations with advanced AI that can understand context, handle interruptions, and deliver human-like responses over the phone. Unlike text-based chatbots, SeaVoice[FR] handles actual voice calls with natural speech patterns.

q2.question: [FR]How long does it take to set up?
q2.answer: [FR]Setup typically takes less than 20 minutes. You can train your voice agent, connect your phone system, set up call rules, and go live in one session.

q3.question: [FR]Can callers tell they're speaking with an AI?
q3.answer: [FR]Our advanced voice technology creates very human-like conversations. While some callers may notice, most find the experience natural and helpful. You can also customize the AI to introduce itself as an AI assistant if preferred.

q4.question: [FR]What happens if SeaVoice[FR] can't answer a question?
q4.answer: SeaVoice[FR] is designed to handle escalations gracefully. It can transfer calls to human agents, take messages, schedule callbacks, or direct callers to appropriate resources based on your configured rules.

q5.question: [FR]How does pricing work?
q5.answer: [FR]We offer transparent per-minute pricing. Premium plans include base minutes with additional usage billed per minute. Enterprise plans are customized based on volume and specific needs.

q6.question: [FR]Can I customize the AI's voice?
q6.answer: [FR]Yes! You can choose from multiple voice options, adjust tone and speaking style, and even clone custom voices for Enterprise plans. The AI can be trained to match your brand's communication style.

q7.question: [FR]Is SeaVoice[FR] multilingual?
q7.answer: [FR]Yes, SeaVoice[FR] supports conversations in over 10 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Chinese, and Japanese.

q8.question: [FR]What industries benefit most from SeaVoice[FR]?
q8.answer: SeaVoice[FR] works well across industries including healthcare, real estate, hospitality, financial services, e-commerce, professional services, and any business that handles high call volumes or needs 24/7 availability.

q9.question: [FR]Can SeaVoice[FR] handle emergency calls?
q9.answer: [FR]While SeaVoice[FR] can handle urgent inquiries and escalate appropriately, we recommend maintaining direct emergency protocols. SeaVoice[FR] can be configured to immediately transfer emergency-related calls to human operators.

q10.question: [FR]Can SeaVoice[FR] detect spam calls?
q10.answer: [FR]Yes, SeaVoice[FR] includes built-in spam detection that can identify and filter suspicious calls, protecting your business from unwanted interruptions while ensuring legitimate calls get through.

q11.question: [FR]How do I get started?
q11.answer: [FR]Getting started is easy! Book a demo to see SeaVoice[FR] in action, then our team will help you set up your voice agent, integrate with your phone system, and configure it for your specific needs. Most customers are up and running within a day.
